newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Honko IPO seen 28 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Honko IPO seen 28 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in transistors maker and distributor Honko International Holdings Ltd is expected to be about 28 times subscribed at the close of its public offer on Friday, market sources said.
The company is expected to announce the subscription results on October 8 and dealing in the shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange is expected to begin on October 14.

Honko offered 67 million new shares, representing 25 percent of the company's expanded share capital, at HK$1.0 per share in a public offer with one free warrant attached for every five shares subscribed.
It said the proceeds would be used to expand its production facilities.
Standard Chartered Asia Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
